nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping _balances storing token balance per address
ERC20 private _totalSupply tracking total minted tokens
ERC20 nested mapping _allowances for spender approvals
NativeMetaTransaction nonces mapping used to prevent meta-transaction replay
AccessControl _roles mapping of role to RoleData members and admin role
EIP712Base domainSeperator hash used for typed message hashing
Constant bytes32 PREDICATE_ROLE granting bridge minting rights
EVEExchangeERC20 constructor: sets contract id, admin and predicate roles, mints 100000000e18 and initializes EIP712
External mint(address user, uint256 amount) restricted to PREDICATE_ROLE, delegates to _mint
EVEExchangeERC20._msgSender override returning ContextMixin.msgSender()
executeMetaTransaction verifies signature, increments nonce, emits event and performs a low-level call to self with appended userAddress
NativeMetaTransaction.verify uses ecrecover to authenticate the meta-transaction signer
ContextMixin.msgSender reads the trailing 20 bytes of msg.data via assembly when called by the contract itself, else msg.sender
ERC20._mint increases _totalSupply and credits _balances, invoking _beforeTokenTransfer
ERC20._transfer debits sender and credits recipient balances using SafeMath
AccessControl._grantRole adds account to role members and emits RoleGranted
AccessControl._revokeRole removes account from role members and emits RoleRevoked
AccessControl.grantRole requires caller to hold role admin rights before granting
AccessControl.revokeRole requires caller to hold role admin rights before revoking
AccessControl._setupRole internal initial role assignment without checks
ERC20 hook _beforeTokenTransfer invoked before mint, burn and transfer
EIP712Base._initializeEIP712 initializer setting the domain separator
AccessControlMixin._setupContractId sets the revert message prefix
External caller msg.sender used for role checks, meta-transaction relayer and context resolution
address(this).call(abi.encodePacked(functionSignature, userAddress)) arbitrary low-level self-call in executeMetaTransaction
ecrecover in verify used for signer authentication of meta-transactions
Inline assembly mload of msg.data in ContextMixin.msgSender extracting the caller address from appended calldata
SafeMath subtraction applied to _balances inside _transfer
address user parameter of mint, recipient of newly minted tokens
uint256 amount parameter of mint, quantity of tokens minted
address userAddress parameter of executeMetaTransaction, signer and appended calldata address
bytes functionSignature parameter of executeMetaTransaction executed via low-level call
uint8 sigV recovery id of the meta-transaction signature
address signer parameter of verify compared against ecrecover output
bytes32 role parameter of grantRole identifying the role to grant
address account parameter of grantRole receiving the role
string name parameter of the ERC20 constructor setting the token name
MetaTransaction memory metaTx local struct built in executeMetaTransaction for hashing
bytes returnData local holding the result of the low-level self-call in executeMetaTransaction

edges.reason: user parameter is consumed by mint to select the token recipient
amount parameter is consumed by mint as minting quantity
mint delegates the balance update to internal _mint
user is forwarded as the account argument of _mint
amount is forwarded to _mint for balance and supply updates
_mint credits _balances[account] with new tokens
_mint increases _totalSupply
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_transfer writes debited and credited values into _balances
_transfer performs SafeMath subtraction on balances
result of the subtraction is stored back into _balances
executeMetaTransaction calls verify to validate the signature
executeMetaTransaction increments the nonces entry for the user
verify relies on ecrecover output to authorize the meta-transaction signer
executeMetaTransaction performs a low-level call to address(this) after state changes
userAddress is appended to the calldata of the low-level self-call and later extracted
the self-call re-enters the contract and reaches ContextMixin.msgSender which decodes the appended address
msgSender reads the appended msg.data using inline assembly
msgSender compares msg.sender with address(this) to decide the caller resolution path
the constructor uses _msgSender for the initial admin role and initial mint
_msgSender returns msg.sender when not a meta-transaction
_msgSender override delegates to ContextMixin.msgSender
the only(PREDICATE_ROLE) modifier checks msg.sender before minting
PREDICATE_ROLE gates execution of mint
grantRole requires msg.sender to hold the role admin rights
revokeRole requires msg.sender to hold the role admin rights
grantRole delegates the membership update to _grantRole
revokeRole delegates the membership update to _revokeRole
_grantRole adds the account to _roles members set
_revokeRole removes the account from _roles members set
_setupRole calls _grantRole without access checks
constructor assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and PREDICATE_ROLE via _setupRole
constructor mints the initial 100000000e18 token supply
constructor initializes the EIP712 domain separator
constructor sets the contract id revert message
_initializeEIP712 writes the computed domainSeperator
userAddress builds the MetaTransaction and is appended to the calldata
functionSignature is hashed and executed by the low-level call
sigV is passed from executeMetaTransaction into verify
signer parameter is compared with the ecrecover result in verify
role parameter selects which role is granted and whose admin is checked
account parameter is the role recipient in grantRole
metaTx local struct is constructed and hashed in executeMetaTransaction
returnData local captures the low-level call output returned to the caller
ERC20 name parameter is forwarded to the base ERC20 constructor

normalization_plan.reason: address user parameter is used exclusively by the mint function
uint256 amount parameter is used exclusively by the mint function
userAddress parameter belongs to executeMetaTransaction and its appended calldata
functionSignature parameter is consumed by the low-level call in executeMetaTransaction
sigV is only meaningful for the ecrecover based verify logic
signer parameter exists solely for the verify signature check
role parameter is only used by grantRole and the _roles mapping
account parameter is only used by grantRole to receive the role
name parameter is only used during constructor initialization of the token
metaTx local struct is scoped to executeMetaTransaction
returnData local is scoped to the low-level call in executeMetaTransaction
